arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Monthly national defense expenditures for calendar year 1940 (in millions)
months = {
    'January': 132,
    'February': 129,
    'March': 143,
    'April': 159,
    'May': 154,
    'June': 153,
    'July': 177,
    'August': 200,
    'September': 219,
    'October': 287,
    'November': 376,
    'December': 473
}

total = sum(months.values())
print(f'Monthly values: {list(months.values())}')
print(f'Calendar Year 1940 Total National Defense Expenditures: {total} millions')
"
